Requirements for widgets

Normative behaviour of the ui-tree, the 51 widgets, keys, actions, popups, focus and render-time caps.

The rows follow the format and the observation channels of the requirements index. The id prefix is WID.

Id Requirement Source Observable test
[WID-001] The widget catalogue MUST hold 51 widgets in 7 families. A plugin MUST describe a view only with these widgets. the seven families (install-error) run the check tool over the widget pages -> 51 distinct widget names.
[WID-002] A ui-tree MUST be a flat list of nodes whose root is node 0. Every child index MUST be in range and greater than its parent index, and a node MUST have at most one parent. Any violation, including a cycle, MUST trap with ui.invalid-tree. the ui tree (trap) return a node whose child index is 99 of 5 nodes -> trap ui.invalid-tree.
[WID-003] A key MUST be unique across the whole view, not only among siblings. A duplicate key MUST trap with ui.duplicate-key. the ui tree (trap) two nodes with key "save" in different branches -> trap ui.duplicate-key.
[WID-004] A tree MUST NOT hold more nodes than the effective ui_tree_nodes limit, 4,096 by default. errors and edge cases (trap) 4,097 nodes -> trap.
[WID-005] A layout MUST have as many constraints as children. A mismatch MUST trap. errors and edge cases (trap) layout with 3 children and 2 constraints -> trap.
[WID-006] A layout percentage above 100 MUST be clamped to 100. errors and edge cases (screen-text) percentage 150 in a 40 column row -> the child gets 40 columns.
[WID-007] Fixed, min, max, percentage, ratio and fill constraints MUST be solved in the order given on the layout page, and the cells MUST sum to the area width. how the solver divides one row (screen-text) fixed 10 and fill in 40 columns -> 10 and 30.
[WID-008] A widget action MUST reach the plugin as a ui-action event carrying the node key and the action value. actions back to the plugin (event-delivery) click a button with key "save" -> ui-action key "save".
[WID-009] Host-owned state (scroll offset, text cursor, selected tab) MUST survive a re-render when the key is unchanged. keys and host owned state (screen-text) scroll a list, re-render with the same key -> the offset stays.
[WID-010] A node with pointer-events and without focusable MUST send no pointer actions. edge cases and errors (event-delivery) click such a node -> no ui-action.
[WID-011] Escape MUST be reserved by the host and resolved in this order: a capturing key-capture, a text selection, the topmost popup, then a modal panel. A modal popup MUST send closed. Escape (event-delivery) press Escape in an open modal popup -> closed arrives and the popup is gone.
[WID-012] More than 4 open popups in one view MUST make open-popup fail with quota-exceeded. edge cases and errors (sync-return) open a fifth popup -> err quota-exceeded.
[WID-013] A code-view on a buffer the plugin did not create MUST need editor.read, and a terminal-view MUST need terminal.read-screen. Without the grant the widget MUST draw an empty frame with the text "not permitted". edge cases and errors (screen-text) terminal-view without the grant -> frame with "not permitted".
[WID-014] views.render has no result type. A render that breaks a limit (ui.too-large, ui.too-deep, ui.widget-not-allowed, ui.invalid-tree, ui.duplicate-key) MUST trap the render call with trap.invalid-ui-tree and the matching ui.* code as its detail reason, an item-count overflow trapping with ui.invalid-tree (WID-020). The host MUST log one error with the widget path, keep the last good tree on screen marked stale and count one failure. edge cases and errors (trap) check-list with 257 items -> trap, the previous tree stays, and one log line with the widget path.
[WID-015] A tooltip longer than 200 Unicode scalar values MUST be cut at 199 and end with the ellipsis. It MUST NOT be an error. edge cases and errors (screen-text) tooltip of 300 characters -> 200 cells ending in the ellipsis.
[WID-016] In a settings view, a widget outside the allowed subset MUST trap the render call with ui.widget-not-allowed: the host logs one error with the widget path, keeps the last good tree and counts one failure. settings views (trap) render a terminal-view in a settings view -> trap ui.widget-not-allowed, previous tree stays.
[WID-020] check-list MUST accept at most 256 items and list-editor at most 64 (1,024 with limits_tier first-party). requestable limits (trap) list-editor with 65 items as T2 -> trap with ui.invalid-tree, the previous tree stays, one error logged.
[WID-021] meter MUST have at most 8 segments, minimap at most 4,096 marks per layer, and spinner at most 16 custom frames. requestable limits (trap) meter with 9 segments -> trap with ui.invalid-tree logged.
[WID-022] The calendar widget (unstable) MUST show one month with Monday first, and MUST need the unstable list to include it. calendar (install-error) use calendar without listing it in unstable -> manifest.unstable-missing.
[WID-023] A ratio below 0 or above 1 MUST be clamped to the range and NaN MUST draw as 0. A progress-row percent above 100 MUST be clamped to 100. edge cases and errors (screen-text) gauge ratio 1.5 -> drawn full. NaN -> drawn empty.
[WID-024] chart MUST draw Braille where the terminal supports it and a text-line fallback otherwise. chart (screen-text) same chart at two capability levels -> Braille and text-line renders.
[WID-025] Text widgets MUST wrap at the area width. paragraph spans that carry an action MUST send it when clicked. widgets text (event-delivery) click an action span -> ui-action with that action.
[WID-026] Input widgets MUST send their change per the debounce rule: toggles, choices and confirmations at once, typed text after the debounce. A text-area with debounce-ms unset MUST wait 600 ms up to 10,000 bytes of text and 1,000 ms above, re-evaluated at each keystroke. An explicit debounce-ms MUST win. This rule covers the changed event of a text-area widget in a plugin view only; a text-area row of a settings tab is written 1 s after the last keystroke (SET-023). when the plugin hears about a change (event-delivery) type 10,001 bytes into a text-area -> changed after 1,000 ms; with debounce-ms 200 -> after 200 ms.
[WID-027] The ui-action event MUST carry five fields, and action-id MUST be a copy of key in 0.1.0. keys are action ids (event-delivery) click toggle key "dark" -> ui-action key "dark" and action-id "dark".
[WID-028] An image whose asset is missing, corrupt, unsupported or over 16 MiB MUST draw an empty frame with the text "image not available". A code-view or terminal-view that names a missing buffer or pane MUST draw an empty frame with the text "not found". widgets media and embedded (screen-text) image with a missing asset -> frame with "image not available". terminal-view of a closed pane -> "not found".
[WID-017] A tree deeper than 32 levels, counting the root as level 1, MUST trap with ui.too-deep. the ui tree (trap) a chain of 33 nested blocks -> trap ui.too-deep.
[WID-018] Tab MUST visit focusable nodes with tab-index 1 or more in ascending order, then nodes with none or 0 in tree pre-order, and MUST skip negative values and nodes with disabled-reason. focus order (event-delivery) tab-index 2 then 1 then none -> focus visits 1, 2, none.
[WID-019] Cell width MUST follow one rule for every widget: the host width of a string in cells, with wide glyphs as 2 and combining marks as 0. cell width (screen-text) a label of 3 wide glyphs in 6 cells -> fits without cut.
[WID-029] A popup or dialog node MUST take no space in its parent layout. A popup id MUST be the node key and unique across a plugin's open views, and close-popup on an unopened id MUST be a no-op that returns ok. popups and anchors (screen-text) a length(0) slot holding a popup leaves the sibling area unchanged.
[WID-030] A theme change MUST repaint the last tree of every open view, deliver theme-changed and trigger exactly one views.render per open view. rendering triggers (event-delivery) switch theme -> one theme-changed and one render.
